name: core-ultra-layout-v1
note: The design factors a design condition is made of, the values the reference layout engine draws for each, and the layout families: each family is one named combination of factor values. The scene model is given the factor values, never a family's name. `preset` for density and spacing means the heights and distances are the visual preset's own. A changed layout is a new version of this file, never an edit to this one once a dataset has been generated from it.
